rules.instruction: Model classes: BankCard, User. Enumeration types: CardCatalog, CardStatus. Preserve these model names exactly. Typed local helper and iterator names may be introduced; they are not new model elements.
BankCard.Balance: Real. Access this attribute through a binding of BankCard or a compatible subtype; preserve its declared spelling and value type.
BankCard.CardID: Integer. Access this attribute through a binding of BankCard or a compatible subtype; preserve its declared spelling and value type.
BankCard.CardStatus: CardStatus. Access this attribute through a binding of BankCard or a compatible subtype; preserve its declared spelling and value type.
BankCard.Catalog: CardCatalog. Access this attribute through a binding of BankCard or a compatible subtype; preserve its declared spelling and value type.
BankCard.Password: Integer. Access this attribute through a binding of BankCard or a compatible subtype; preserve its declared spelling and value type.
User.Address: String. Access this attribute through a binding of User or a compatible subtype; preserve its declared spelling and value type.
User.Name: String. Access this attribute through a binding of User or a compatible subtype; preserve its declared spelling and value type.
User.UserID: Integer. Access this attribute through a binding of User or a compatible subtype; preserve its declared spelling and value type.

BankCard.BelongedUser: User. This is a single-valued navigation. Navigate as an object; link assignment or clearing requires an explicit requirement. The declaration alone does not require creation, deletion, inverse updates, or a nonempty value.

User.OwnedCard: BankCard. This is a single-valued navigation. Navigate as an object; link assignment or clearing requires an explicit requirement. The declaration alone does not require creation, deletion, inverse updates, or a nonempty value.
CardCatalog: use only CardCatalog::CREDIT, CardCatalog::DESPOSIT. Preserve source spellings; do not introduce aliases.
CardStatus: use only CardStatus::CANNEL, CardStatus::NORMAL, CardStatus::SUSPEND. Preserve source spellings; do not introduce aliases.
Parameter balance: Real. Reference it as balance, not self.balance; preserve its declared name and type.
Parameter cardid: Integer. Reference it as cardid, not self.cardid; preserve its declared name and type.
Parameter cardstatus: CardStatus. Reference it as cardstatus, not self.cardstatus; preserve its declared name and type.
Parameter catalog: CardCatalog. Reference it as catalog, not self.catalog; preserve its declared name and type.
Parameter password: Integer. Reference it as password, not self.password; preserve its declared name and type.
Service state self.CardIDValidated: Boolean. Access it through self; the model declaration does not itself require changing it.
Service state self.DepositedNumber: Real. Access it through self; the model declaration does not itself require changing it.
Service state self.InputCard: BankCard. Access it through self; the model declaration does not itself require changing it.
Service state self.IsDeposit: Boolean. Access it through self; the model declaration does not itself require changing it.
Service state self.IsWithdraw: Boolean. Access it through self; the model declaration does not itself require changing it.
Service state self.PasswordValidated: Boolean. Access it through self; the model declaration does not itself require changing it.
Service state self.WithdrawedNumber: Real. Access it through self; the model declaration does not itself require changing it.
The operation returns Boolean. Use result only in the postcondition, with a compatible value satisfying the stated return obligation; do not assume a Boolean result is true.
